testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, sidebar links, top header actions, KPI cards, table rows, action buttons, modals, drawers, and form inputs MUST include clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='sidebar-nav-network-autos', data-testid='kpi-card-total-autos', data-testid='table-row-108', data-testid='btn-create-campaign', data-testid='help-drawer-trigger').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_standards: WCAG AA contrast ratios, Alpine.js keyboard focus trapping on overlays, aria-expanded state on dropdowns and sidebar groups.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent background on fixed headers, dropdowns, or drawer overlays.
Maintain strict dark background palette (#070A10 / #0B0F17 / #111827) with tactical Amber (#F59E0B) highlights.
Use Barlow Condensed for headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for body text, and JetBrains Mono for data numbers, codes, and currency.
Every table, KPI widget, and form must handle loading, empty, and error database states gracefully.
Attach data-testid attributes to every navigation element, action button, filter input, and table cell action.
Ensure total stack adherence: Laravel 12 Blade + Tailwind CSS + Alpine.js + Lucide Icons + Chart.js.
